limitations: Timing is current local preloaded fixed-byte replay only. It cannot rule out historical temporary disk/CPU/antivirus/scheduling stalls or assign remaining time to network/Cloudflare.

Original chunk timestamps are post rawwrite/hash and pre current JSONLwrite; interchunk gaps mix reader wait, preceding progress persist, copy/write/hash and scheduling, rather than pure network arrival.
Original complete and partial bodies, actual failures and unchanged 30/60-second deadlines are preserved. Diagnostic exit0 is not production performance PASS.
